_about: LIN-4514 pre-landing readings from production (slice 3, before verdicts and changes become records). Read-only, through railway ssh into harbour-cat with the deployed build: docs/reviews/slice-3-readings/production-read.mjs (it calls scripts/records-readings.mjs readFromDb and scripts/stability-measures-core.mjs heldRunReading, slice 2's method, LIN-4506). Only reading output was printed; no environment, no workspace key, no record contents. Readings are reported, never a gate.

blindReadQueries.method: every records query-log row whose asker is a blind-read run (by = run:<id> of a run record by blind-read), classified by what it named; the join was checked: of the query log's run askers, those matched to run records are counted by their run's stage

heldRuns.method: slice 2's (LIN-4499 comment of 20 Nov 21:47, section 1): records-readings.mjs readFromDb, and the same data passed to heldRunReading for its per-record sample, split by addressee
